title: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 Review: Racing a Bang Thao Beach Resort
meta_description: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 review: June 12 at Laguna Phuket -- five distances through a major integrated resort complex, priority registration for returners.
dek: Set for 12 June 2027 at Laguna Phuket in Ban Bang Thao, this marathon runs through a major integrated beach resort complex, offering priority registration to 2026 edition finishers ahead of general sign-up.
verdict: The Laguna Phuket Marathon runs through Laguna Phuket, a large integrated resort complex on Bang Thao Beach -- genuinely resort-grade infrastructure and scenery, distinct from the city-street and civic-plaza venues dominating most of this research batch. Five distances (2K to full marathon) give it the widest range of nearly any race covered here. Priority registration is already open specifically for 2026 finishers, ahead of general sign-up -- a loyalty-driven registration model suggesting a well-established, repeat-participant race.
